# Vendored NEBRA UI runtime

This directory contains the compiled `@nebra/ui` snapshot used by NEBRA Super Admin.

- Source of truth: `abod-haes/nebra-web-components`
- Generated branch: `dist-snapshot`
- Exact source revision: see `SOURCE_COMMIT`

Do not edit generated runtime or declaration files manually. Update the shared UI source, require its CI to pass, then synchronize the refreshed snapshot.
